label: Application ID
description: Case-sensitive app ID, such as org.mozilla.firefox or steam_app_*.

label: XWayland class
description: Match an X11 application by its window class.

label: Window title
description: Match a title, such as *Settings*. Use * for any text and ? for one character.

label: Content type
description: Match the content type reported by the application. This limits the rule to visual effects.

label: Layout
description: Choose a layout for this window. Stacking is the floating layout.

label: Monitor
description: Exact connector name from Displays, such as DP-1.

label: Workspace
description: Workspace number, starting at 1.

label: Float this window
description: Allow the window to use freeform placement.

label: Fullscreen
description: Request fullscreen for the matching window.

label: Full-width scrolling column
description: Set the initial column width when using the scrolling layout.

label: Use reserved screen areas
description: Allow placement in screen space reserved for panels and docks.

label: Width
description: Initial window width, from 1 to 100000.

label: Height
description: Initial window height, from 1 to 100000.

label: Horizontal offset
description: Horizontal placement offset, from -100000 to 100000.

label: Vertical offset
description: Vertical placement offset, from -100000 to 100000.

label: Placement
description: Choose how a floating window is initially positioned.

label: Stack layer
description: Place the window below, alongside, or above other windows.

label: Allow focus
description: Choose whether this window can receive focus.

label: Keep position fixed
description: Prevent the window from being repositioned.

label: Hide from window switcher
description: Exclude the window from the window switcher.

label: Hide from taskbar
description: Exclude the window from taskbar listings.

label: Background blur
description: Choose whether blur is enabled for this window.

label: Opacity
description: 0 is transparent; 1 is opaque. For example, 0.85 means 85% opacity.

label: HDR expansion
description: Override automatic HDR expansion on compatible HDR outputs.

label: Buffer scaling
description: Choose native scaling or round the buffer scale up to a whole number.

label: Hardware overlay
description: Prefer hardware overlay promotion when the output and backend support it.

label: Anchor
description: Position the game within its available area.

label: Game size
description: Use native, a size such as 1920x1080, or fractions such as 0.8x0.8.

label: Game scale
description: Scale factor greater than 0 and up to 16. For example, 1.5.
